about_the_game:
Run on any wall. Grapple rooftops. Call in your mech, then blow the map to pieces.

ShatterRush is a multiplayer parkour FPS where fluid movement meets massive mechs in fully destructible levels to create flow-state combat you’ve been waiting years for!

ShatterRush is a high-speed parkour FPS with massive battle mechs and fully destructible arenas. Master momentum to outplay rivals in 16-player combat where the battlefield reshapes every fight.

Key Features

  • Advanced Movement, Instantly Familiar: Feel the rush as you wall-run, slide, double jump, mantle, dash, stim and grapple with a movement system that is incredibly easy to learn, yet feels right at home with other games you've played before.

  • No Permament Cover: Blast through walls, floors, and rooftops to create new sightlines, escape routes, and flanks. Nearly every single building in the map can be levelled - adapt or be left in the rubble.

  • Mech Mayhem: Deploy a towering war-machine and literally level the playing field with overpowered weaponry that can turn the tide of battle.

Some of ShatterRush's best features, like advanced Source-style movement, playable mechs, and splitscreen have all been implemented directly based off feedback from the community.

We believe that by developing in lock-step with our community, we can truly deliver the movement shooter you've been waiting years for. Our Open Pre-Alpha is available right now for this very reason - so you can be part of the community that shapes this game's future!

We love the movement-shooter space, and we are designing ShatterRush to be the stim-shot this genre needs:

  • Accessible For All: ShatterRush is designed to be fun at all skill levels, on a variety of hardware setups. Expect incredible high-skill depth for pro players, and fun chaotic action for new players, with performant gameplay that runs well on most modern hardware.

  • Split-Screen Multiplayer: Bringing back the glory days of couch gaming, ShatterRush already includes full split-screen support, even when playing global online multiplayer!

  • Regular, Community-Driven Updates: We release major updates to our Open Pre-Alpha every 2-3 weeks based on feedback from our players. Be part of the change!

Are you ready to feel the Rush?

Download our Open Pre-Alpha for free, and wishlist now!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i3-3225 3.3 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000; AMD Radeon Vega 8
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i5-7300U 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

Wallrun, grapple, and smash through cover to outplay your foes in kinetic, high-speed combat as the map changes with every fight. Join the rush in our free Open Pre-Alpha & wishlist now!
